exactPrompt:
Create ONE original pixel-art inventory icon atlas for ASHVEIL, a grounded, melancholy dark-fantasy survival game in an ash-covered forest. Exactly FOUR separate harvested bear materials in a TWO columns by TWO rows atlas. These are original assets, no copied or traced commercial-game artwork. Match a restrained existing handmade ASHVEIL material language: crisp deliberate pixel clusters, charcoal and warm-grey edges, muted brown/ivory/olive material colors, restrained upper-left highlights, subtle dark broken outlines. Compact readable silhouettes must remain recognizably different when each complete icon is displayed at only 32 by 32 pixels. Favor a few strong material planes and large defining folds over noisy tiny marks; no smooth 3D render, cute cartoon, sticker border, glow or glossy UI treatment.

Full canvas TRUE transparent RGBA background. Four equal roomy square cells, two rows. Large fully transparent gutters and generous transparent padding around each object. Every complete object fits entirely within its own cell, occupies at most 68 percent of cell width/height, and never touches a neighboring object. Nothing cut off. No drawn grid, labels, text, figures, hands, animals, ground, cast shadow, frames, scenery, symbols, extra props or extra items.

TOP LEFT: ONE folded bundle of thick, broad, heavy RAW CINDER BEAR HIDE. Wide horizontal compact silhouette, two substantial overlapping folds with unmistakable dense coarse CHARCOAL-BLACK fur and a small dull brown-grey raw inner edge. Heavy long coarse shaggy tufts at irregular outer edges, a broad dark mass with clear grey fold ridges. Visibly thicker, wider and much blacker than an ordinary brown deer hide or grey-brown boar hide. No bear face, head, paws, tail, claws, belt, buckle, rope, finished garment or tanned leather roll.

TOP RIGHT: ONE irregular lobed lump of raw BEAR FAT, pale yellow-white warm ivory waxy fat, rounded heavy lobes and a few shallow buttery folds. Compact near-square lumpy silhouette. Solid food material with one restrained oily warm highlight and soft ochre shadows. NO pink or red rind, NO meat, bone, blood, plate, paper or wrapping. It must look like a raw fat lump, not a smooth stone, loaf, organ, candle or rectangular boar-lard slice.

BOTTOM LEFT: ONE large thick naturally CURVED BEAR CLAW, an unmistakable broad keratin claw with a very thick dark charcoal-brown cut root, strongly hooked curved body and pointed worn grey-ivory tip. The dark thick root and outer shell dominate; only the tapering inner ridge/tip lightens. Strong compact C-shaped hook silhouette, asymmetrical, heavy and blunt at the root, sharp at the tip. It is a single bear claw, not a pale boar tusk, deer antler, horn, human tooth, talon bunch, necklace, knife or metal object. No flesh or separate loose fragments.

BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE small sealed bottle of BEAR BILE. A short sturdy dull translucent brown glass vial with a narrow neck, tightly fitted dark cork and plain worn brown wax seal, no writing or label. Inside is murky BROWN-GREEN olive bile with a clearly visible horizontal liquid line and a dark olive body. A tiny muted glass edge highlight only; no magical glow, blue glass, colorful potion shine, floating bubbles, decorative jewelry, straps, metal gadget or medicine box. Entire cork and rounded squat bottle base included. Distinct upright bottle silhouette.

Consistent grounded material rendering and lighting across all four objects. Each image is a single standalone inventory material. Do not add a fifth object. Produce exactly one transparent PNG atlas.
